title: Tlaib, Democrats Call for Israel to Release Palestinian Doctors From Detention
content:
Israel has killed over 1,700 Palestinian health care workers in three years of genocide in Gaza.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

A group of House Democrats has called for Israel to release hundreds of health care workers, including physicians like Hussam Abu Safiya, from detention as Israel’s genocide in Gaza reaches into its fourth year.

Six Democrats, led by Rep. Jesús “Chuy” García (Illinois), released a joint statement on Tuesday condemning Israel for its “systematic persecution” of Palestinian health care workers and demanding their release from arbitrary detention.

“Over the last three years, the Israeli government has systematically destroyed the health system in Palestine, murdering at least 1,700 Palestinian doctors, nurses, paramedics, and other healthcare workers and destroying dozens of hospitals. It has arrested and arbitrarily detained hundreds of Palestinian healthcare workers, including at least 16 physicians who continue to be held in inhumane conditions,” the lawmakers wrote.

The Democrats specifically call for the release of Abu Safiya, who Israel has held in its torture camps for nearly two years, where they have starved and tortured him, his lawyer says. Abu Safiya is a pediatrician who served as the director of Kamal Adwan Hospital in northern Gaza when Israel besieged the area.

The world watched in December 2024 as Israel’s ground raid closed in on Kamal Adwan, with Israeli forces eventually ordering the entire facility to be evacuated, setting it ablaze and arresting Abu Safiya. The hospital was left in ruins after Israeli soldiers were done with it.

“Among [those detained] is Dr. Hussam Abu Safiya, whom the Israeli government has arbitrarily detained since 2024 and tortured to the point of near-death after previously murdering his son and brutally attacking his hospital,” the lawmakers went on.

The statement was signed by Representatives Pramila Jayapal (Washington), Summer Lee (Pennsylvania), Ilhan Omar (Minnesota), Delia C. Ramirez (Illinois), and Rashida Tlaib (D-Michigan).

Israel's systematic destruction of the Palestinian healthcare system and targeting of healthcare workers is at the heart of its genocide. We must stand up for those targeted for saving lives. Free Dr. Hussam Abu Safiya. Free Dr. Mazen Rantisi. Free Dr. Dima Amin.…

The Democrats also called for an end to arms transfers to Israel and urged Congress to block the Trump administration’s planned $2.8 billion package of 2,000-pound bombs to Israel — which is slated to be paid for by U.S. taxpayers. Other Democrats have also vowed to work against that transfer.

In three years of genocide in Gaza, Israel has killed more than 1,700 health care workers and has left zero hospitals fully functioning in the enclave. Israeli forces have also detained more than 400 health care workers from Gaza without charges or a trial in their torture camps.

Israel has killed nearly 600 aid workers since October 7, 2023, according to UN counts.

“Over the past three years, people’s ability to access health care in Gaza has deteriorated dramatically, with medical facilities lying in ruins, hospitals increasingly running out of basic supplies, and patients unable to access essential medicines and treatments. Restrictions on essential supplies such as engine oil and spare parts are also crippling the infrastructure needed to keep hospitals, ambulances, and water systems running, with generators breaking down and water-trucking operations reduced,” said Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) in a statement on Monday.

“It will take generations to recover from the harm that has already been done over the past three years, and in the preceding decades, while the excruciating consequences of Israel’s ongoing genocide are still being felt every day,” said Amande Bazerolle, the head of MSF’s emergency response in Gaza.

title: 'Aile Sağlığı Merkezleri, satılacak bina değil, sağlık merkezidir'
content:
Eylem Nazlıer [email protected]

Türkiye’de koruyucu, birinci basamak sağlık hizmetlerinin yurttaşla buluştuğu en önemli noktalardan biri olan Aile Sağlığı Merkezlerinin (ASM) geleceği, merkezlerin fiziki koşullarından kira giderlerine, deprem güvenliğinden personel eksikliğine kadar risk altında. Kamuya ait binalarda bile kiralarına yüzde 300’e varan zamlar istenen ASM’lerde aile hekimleri zor durumda.

Birlik ve Dayanışma Sendikası Genel Başkanı Dr. Ahmet Mehlepçi, ASM’lerin mümkün olduğunca kamuya ait, depreme dayanıklı ve sağlık hizmetinin gerektirdiği fiziki standartlara uygun binalarda hizmet vermesi gerektiğine vurgu yaparak “ASM’ler yalnızca hekim, ebe ve hemşirelerin görev yaptığı binalar değildi. ASM’ler; koruyucu sağlık hizmetlerinin, gebe, bebek ve çocuk izlemlerinin, bağışıklama hizmetlerinin, kronik hastalık takiplerinin ve vatandaşın sağlık sistemiyle ilk temasının gerçekleştiği temel sağlık kuruluşlarıdır” hatırlatmasını yaptı. Bu nedenle ASM’lerin geleceğine ilişkin kararların yalnızca bina, taşınmaz veya bütçe konusu olarak değerlendirilemeyeceğini dile getiren Mehlepçi, “Konu doğrudan sağlık hizmetine erişim, hizmetin sürekliliği ve kamu yararıdır” diye konuştu.

Sağlık Bakanı Kemal Memişoğlu’nun Kasım 2025’te 1000 yeni ASM yapacaklarını açıklamasından bu yana sadece 278 ASM’nin hizmete girdiğini, 370 ASM’nin inşaatının sürdüğünü ve 352 ASM’nin proje aşamasında olduğu bilgisini veren Mehlepçi, Türkiye genelinde ise yaklaşık 8 bin 300 ASM bulunduğunu söyledi.

Yeni ASM yatırımlarının elbette önemli olduğunu belirten Mehlepçi, mevcut merkezlerin ise kentsel dönüşüm, deprem riski, yüksek kiralar veya taşınmaz satışları nedeniyle hizmet dışı kalmasının önlenmesi gerektiğini vurguladı.

Bir taraftan yeni ASM’ler yapılırken diğer taraftan mevcut merkezlerin kentsel dönüşüm, deprem riski, yüksek kiralar veya taşınmaz satışları nedeniyle hizmet dışı kalma tehlikesiyle karşı karşıya olduğuna dikkati çeken Mehlpeçi “Mart 2026’da TBMM’ye sunulan soru önergesine verilen cevapta İstanbul Kadıköy’deki 33 ASM’den 7’sinin kentsel dönüşüm nedeniyle yıkıldığı ve hizmet veremez hale geldiğini söyledi. Mahlepçi kaç yeni ASM açıldığı kadar, kaç ASM’nin kapandığı, yıkıldığı, tahliye edildiği, taşındığı veya başka bir ASM’nin içine sıkıştırıldığının da kamuoyuyla paylaşılması gerektiğini aktardı.

ASM binalarının deprem güvenliğinin de önemli bir sorun olduğunu belirten Mehlepçi, 2025 yılında yapılan bir çalışmada ASM binalarının yaklaşık üçte birinin 1999 öncesinde inşa edildiğinin ortaya çıktığını söyledi. 6 Şubat 2023 yaşanan depremlerde ortaya çıkan tablonun bu konuda vahim olduğunu hatırlatan Mehlepçi “2026 yılı başında sahadan elde edilen verilere göre Hatay’da 96 ASM konteynerlerde hizmet veriyor. 103 ASM kendi binasında hizmet vermeye devam ediyor ancak bunların bir bölümü deprem güvenliği açısından risk taşıyor. Yaklaşık 56 ASM ise tahliye veya yıkım sürecinde” dedi.

Öte yandan ASM’ler için sorunun yalnızca deprem güvenliğiyle sınırlı olmadığını, ASM’lerdeki sağlık hizmetinin niteliği ve çalışanların koşullarını etkileyen başka fiziki sorunların bulunduğunu da dile getiren Mehlepçi durumu şöyle anlattı: “Penceresi, yeterli mekanik havalandırması bulunmayan kan alma odaları, lavabosu olmayan, iki veya üç sağlık çalışanının aynı odayı kullanmak zorunda kaldığı ASM’ler de var. Hatta bazı çalışma alanları hasta mahremiyetini sağlamaya da elverişli değil.”

Yıkım veya tahliye kararı verilen merkezlerde görev yapan sağlık çalışanlarının başka bir ASM’nin mutfağına, dinlenme odasına veya ortak kullanım alanına yerleştirilerek yeni bir aile hekimliği birimi oluşturulmasının kalıcı bir çözüm olmadığının altını çizen Mehlepçi, “Bir sağlık hizmetinin verilebilmesi için yalnızca bir oda bulunması yeterli değildir. O alanın sağlık hizmetinin niteliğine, çalışan güvenliğine ve hasta mahremiyetine uygun olması gerekir” dedi.

Kamusal sağlık hizmeti sunulan ASM’lerde yükün önemli bir bölümünün aile hekimlerinin üzerine yıkıldığına ve özellikle büyükşehirlerde uygun bina bulmanın giderek zorlaştığına işaret eden Mehlepçi “Kiralar da ASM’lerin sürdürülebilirliğini tehdit eden seviyelere ulaştı. Aylık 100 bin TL ve üzerinde kira ödeyen ASM örnekleri var. Elazığ’da bazı ASM’ler yüzde 350’ye varan kira artış talepleriyle karşılaştı. ASM’ler birer ticarethane değildir. Burada yürütülen faaliyet kamu sağlık hizmetidir” uyarısını yaparak buna rağmen yüksek kira bedellerinin yanı sıra elektrik, su, doğalgaz, temizlik, bakım-onarım …

¿QUÉ es el patriotismo? ¿Es el amor por el lugar donde uno nació, el lugar de los recuerdos y las esperanzas de la infancia, de los sueños y las aspiraciones? ¿Es el lugar donde, con ingenuidad infantil, contemplábamos las nubes fugaces y nos preguntábamos por qué nosotros tampoco podíamos correr tan rápido? ¿El lugar donde contábamos los miles de millones de estrellas centelleantes, aterrorizados ante la idea de que cada una de ellas fuera «un ojo» que traspasara lo más profundo de nuestras pequeñas almas? ¿Es el lugar donde escuchábamos el canto de los pájaros y anhelábamos tener alas para volar, como ellos, hacia tierras lejanas? ¿O el lugar donde nos sentábamos a los pies de nuestra madre, embelesados por maravillosos relatos de grandes hazañas y conquistas? En resumen, ¿es el amor por ese lugar, donde cada pulgada representa recuerdos queridos y preciosos de una infancia feliz, alegre y juguetona?

Si eso fuera patriotismo, pocos hombres estadounidenses de hoy en día podrían considerarse patriotas, ya que el lugar de juego se ha convertido en fábrica, molino y mina, mientras que los sonidos ensordecedores de la maquinaria han sustituido a la música de los pájaros. Tampoco podemos ya escuchar las historias de grandes hazañas, pues las que cuentan hoy nuestras madres no son más que historias de dolor, lágrimas y aflicción.

¿Qué es, entonces, el patriotismo? «El patriotismo, señor, es el último recurso de los sinvergüenzas», dijo el Dr. Johnson. León Tolstói, el mayor antipatriota de nuestro tiempo, define el patriotismo como el principio que justifica la formación de asesinos en masa; un oficio que requiere mejor equipamiento para el ejercicio del asesinato que para la fabricación de artículos de primera necesidad como zapatos, ropa y viviendas; un oficio que garantiza mejores beneficios y mayor gloria que el del trabajador medio.

Gustave Hervé [1], otro gran antipatriota, califica acertadamente el patriotismo de superstición —una mucho más perjudicial, brutal e inhumana que la religión—. La superstición de la religión tuvo su origen en la incapacidad del hombre para explicar los fenómenos naturales. Es decir, cuando el hombre primitivo oía un trueno o veía un relámpago, no podía dar una explicación a ninguno de ellos y, por lo tanto, concluía que detrás de ellos debía de haber una fuerza mayor que él mismo. Del mismo modo, veía una fuerza sobrenatural en la lluvia y en los diversos cambios que se producen en la naturaleza. El patriotismo, por el contrario, es una superstición creada artificialmente y mantenida a través de una red de mentiras y falsedades; una superstición que despoja al hombre de su autoestima y dignidad, y aumenta su arrogancia y vanidad.

De hecho, la vanidad, la arrogancia y el egoísmo son los elementos esenciales del patriotismo. Permítanme ilustrarlo. El patriotismo parte de la base de que nuestro planeta está dividido en pequeños rincones, cada uno rodeado por una verja de hierro. Quienes han tenido la suerte de nacer en un rincón concreto se consideran mejores, más nobles, más grandiosos y más inteligentes que los seres vivos que habitan en cualquier otro rincón. Por lo tanto, es deber de todo aquel que vive en ese rincón elegido luchar, matar y morir en el intento de imponer su superioridad sobre todos los demás.

I den ungsocialistiska pressen hade så tidigt som år 1907 agitation förts för syndikalismen. I majnumret år 1910 av den fackliga tidningen Bageriarbetaren gjorde bagarnas förtroendeman, Anders Sjöstedt, som var redaktör för nämnda tidning, ett försök att hindra syndikalismens spridning bland bagarna, vilka i stort antal gripits av den syndikalistiska agitationen. Då skrev undertecknad ett genmäle mot den mäktiga förbundschefens angrepp under rubriken: **.."Man säger... Genmäle på artikeln i majnumret."*

"Man säger, att bagarna skola vara med då det gäller att upplösa förbunden och bilda Lokala Samorganisationer", inledde vår förtroendeman Anders Sjöstedt, och tillade sedan: "Tack för erbjudandet, men skall man då behandla bagarna på samma sätt som man vill göra nu, tycker vi synd om bagarna." På detta sätt vill jag svara att aggressiva kommer arbetsgivarna alltid att vara oavsett vilken organisationsform arbetarna har, tills dess de får så kraftigt mothugg så de lugnar sina rovdjurskänslor. Och då behövs det sannerligen syndikalistiskt försvarskraft. Därför kan inte en förtroendeman, om än med stor vilja, uträtta något ensamt - utan en vaken, handlingsfull och slagkraftig organisation.

Lusten att krossa arbetarnas organisationer har icke saknats av de privata arbetsgivarna - ej ens från styrelser och föreståndare för kooperativa bagerier i södra Sverge. Närmare angivet Skåne. Där har till och med öppna strider utbrutit.

Alla arbetsgivare vill ha utgifterna så små som möjligt. Men inkomsterna så stora som möjligt. Detta får ju främst arbetarna, producenterna, lida för.

Vidare hade Sjöstedt skrivit: "Lyssna på styrelserna för 'Föreningsbagerierna' och och för en del kooperativa bagerier vilka diskutera om bagarna på ett utmanande sätt, när det gäller deras avtal."

För min del tyckte jag att bagarna icke skulle bry sig om vad dessa konservativa styrelsemedlemmar pladdrar om. Och är det någon underhandling de ej vill bry sig om och önskar de icke vara med om någon överenskommelse som vi vet att de kan gå med på, behöver vi icke kompromissa och springa och berusa dessa herrar i all evighet, och tigga om rätt till mänsklig existens. Vi ha förmåga att slå till! Vi äro de starka! Gör slut på fegheten! Det är vi som är producenter!

Därför behöva att omändra organisationerna till kampduglighet och smidig anpassningsförmåga efter de förhållanden som kan uppstå. Vad de Lokala Samorganisationerna angår så äro de mest praktiska, och kan med heder avlösa de gamla tungrodda byråkratiska fackföreningarna, som äro i majoritet i detta land.

Att inte organisationsfrågan är ett aktuellt spörsmål just nu, bland bagarna, är en lögn av stort mått. Den är aktuell och skall bliva det ännu mer när tiden är mogen. Trots vad Sjöstedt skriver! Och hans ångest som så tydligt märks!

Allt sedan de reformistiska organisationernas början har i regel "förts de korslagda armarnas strid", som de gamla ledana är så förtjusta i - till borgardömets fromma!

Detta har visat sig odugligt. Vi har ju bagerier, som är bojkottade ända sedan den tid som "Svenska Bageri- och Konditoriarbetareförbundet" startades. Och det var inte i går!

Vi har exempel på detta i Göteborg och i Uddevalla, ja lite varstans i detta land.

Det skulle taga allt för stort utrymme i anspråk att räkna upp alla. Och när uppgörelse kommer att träffas vet ingen! Och ingen gör något för att ändring skall ske. Ingen delar ut så mycket som en bojkottslapp för att upplysa allmänheten om förhållandet, att konflikt råder. Därför behövs det pigga organisationer i vilka medlemmarna äro socialistiskt skolade och nyktra. Då kan vi marschera framåt och vinna något, trots det att arbetsgivarna göra allt för att slå ned vår frammarsch. Detta få ingen glömma!

Man skriver så ofta och påstår att folk är så egoistiska, att de ej vill betala avgifterna till föreningarna …

author: Fozzie
title: Chapter 25: The General Law of Capitalist Accumulation
content:
Harry Cleaver's study guide to Marx's Capital volume one, chapter 25.

Marx’s opening remarks on the “composition of capital” harken back to the analysis in Chapter 15 on relative surplus value. There we saw how efforts to offset reductions in the working day by raising productivity involved capitalists replacing troublesome workers with compliant machinery. He suggests that the introduction of more machinery per worker can be formulated as a rise in the technical composition of capital, something we can represent symbolically by MP/LP, the material configuration of means of production and labor-power.(1) Looked at from the point of view of of value invested, increased expenditure on machinery raises the value composition of capital, or c/v, a ratio of the value invested in constant capital, c, to that invested in variable capital, v. However, because the value composition can change independently of any change in the technical composition,(2) Marx calls the value composition—when changes are only due to changes in the technical composition—the organic composition of capital. To differentiate, we can represent the organic composition of capital as co/vo. So, c/v can change, even if co/vo does not; but any change in co/vo is also a change in c/v. Therefore, whenever he refers to changes in the organic composition he is talking about a change in the technical composition, but in value terms. Eventually—especially in Volume III of Capital—we find that Marx’s analysis of some tendencies to crisis are formulated in terms of the organic composition of capital.(3)

Although we can analyze these various “compositions of capital” at every level of the economy, from individual enterprises through branches of industry to the total social capital, it is “with this [last] alone that we are concerned here”.(4) In other words, the subject is the expansion of the total social capital. It is therefore vital to be clear about what Marx means by accumulation.

Had he defined accumulation merely as an expansion of the total social capital, it would be easy to confuse accumulation with economists’ concepts of “growth”, or, taking qualitative changes into account, with concepts of “economic development”. But he doesn’t leave it at that; he carefully defines accumulation in social terms as the reproduction “of the capital-relation on an expanded scale, with more capitalists, or bigger capitalists, at one pole, and more wage-laborers at the other pole.”(5) In other words, what is being accumulated are the antagonistic class relationships of capitalism. Unlike economists who recognize neither classes nor class antagonism, and think of growth in terms of production functions such as Q = f(K, L), where factors of production K (capital) and L (labor) produce output (Q) that grows as the economy expands, Marx re-emphasizes here that his interest is precisely those antagonistic relationships within which K (MP or c), L (LP in action or v) and Q (C’ and M’) are only elements or moments.

He then proceeds to discuss the dynamics of accumulation in terms of the relationships between the classes. In this first section he assumes that the composition of capital (by each definition) remains the same, so that when capitalists invest, their money buys both more means of production (MP) and more labor-power (LP). (He relaxes this assumption in the next section.) Under this assumption, capitalist investment increases the demand for labor-power and puts upward pressure on wages as capitalists compete for available workers.(6)

Marx then brings this association between investment and the demand for labor to bear on the analysis of the fluctuations in business activity. He recognizes how downturns and upturns were recurring periodically, but his real interest lay not their periodicity but how major downturns constituted crises for capitalism. That is to say, large-scale layoffs, rising unemployment and increased poverty can lead to worker-led uprisings and a crisis for capitalist control. Unlike economists who prefer the term business cycle, optimiostically presuming that downturns will always be followed by upturns, for Marx each major crisis opened the possibility of the revolutionary overthrow of capitalism.

Assuming a constant composition of capital, as he does in this section, rapid accumulation was achieved by capitalists hiring more labor, sometimes buying new machines and processing more raw materials to produce more output, whether in agriculture …

Среда, 28 августа. – Вечернее заседание.

Огромный зал Планциуса буквально переполнен, когда в 9 часов Ланге объявляет заседание открытым. Повестка дня предусматривает обсуждение следующего вопроса: Синдикализм и Анархизм. Слово в качестве первого докладчика предоставляется товарищу Пьеру Монатту из Парижа, члену комитета Всеобщей конфедерации труда (CGT).

ПЬЕР МОНАТТ. – Моё желание – не столько дать вам теоретическое изложение революционного синдикализма, сколько показать его в деле и тем самым дать говорить фактам. Революционный синдикализм, в отличие от социализма и анархизма, предшествовавших ему на этом поприще, утвердил себя не столько теориями, сколько действиями, и искать его следует больше в действии, чем в книгах.

Нужно быть слепым, чтобы не видеть всего того общего, что есть между анархизмом и синдикализмом. Оба преследуют полное искоренение капитализма и наёмного труда посредством социальной революции. Синдикализм, являющийся доказательством пробуждения рабочего движения, вернул анархизм к сознанию его рабочих истоков; с другой стороны, анархисты немало способствовали тому, чтобы увлечь рабочее движение на революционный путь и популяризировать идею прямого действия. Таким образом, синдикализм и анархизм воздействовали друг на друга к величайшему благу обоих.

Именно во Франции, в рамках Всеобщей Конфедерации Труда (CGT), родились и развились революционно-синдикалистские идеи. Конфедерация занимает совершенно особое место в международном рабочем движении. Это единственная организация, которая, открыто объявляя себя революционной[1], не имеет никаких связей с политическими партиями, даже самыми передовыми. В большинстве других стран, кроме Франции, первые роли играет социал-демократия. Во Франции CGT оставляет далеко позади себя – как по численной силе, так и по оказываемому влиянию – Социалистическую партию: она претендует на то, чтобы представлять одна весь рабочий класс, и она высокомерно отвергла все заигрывания, которые ей делались за последние годы. Автономия составила её силу, и она намерена оставаться автономной.

Эта претензия CGT, её отказ иметь дело с партиями, снискали ей со стороны раздражённых противников эпитет «анархистская». Однако нет ничего более ложного. CGT, обширное объединение профсоюзов и рабочих союзов, не имеет официальной доктрины. Но все доктрины представлены в ней и пользуются равной терпимостью. В конфедеральном комитете есть некоторое число анархистов; они встречаются там и сотрудничают с социалистами, подавляющее большинство которых – следует отметить это мимоходом – не менее враждебно, чем анархисты, всякой мысли о соглашении между профсоюзами и Социалистической партией.

Структура CGT заслуживает того, чтобы о ней знали. В отличие от структуры столь многих других рабочих организаций, она не является ни централистской, ни авторитарной. Конфедеральный комитет – не то, что воображают правители и репортёры буржуазных газет: не директивный комитет, соединяющий в своих руках законодательную и исполнительную власть. Он лишён всякой власти. CGT управляется снизу вверх; у профсоюза нет иного хозяина, кроме него самого; он свободен действовать или не действовать; никакая внешняя по отношению к нему воля никогда не сдержит и не приведет в действие его активность.

Итак, в основе Конфедерации лежит профсоюз. Но профсоюз не входит в Конфедерацию напрямую; он может сделать это лишь через посредство своей отраслевой федерации, с одной стороны, и своей биржи труда, с другой.

Именно объединение федераций между собой и объединение бирж и составляют Конфедерацию.

Конфедеральная жизнь координируется конфедеральным комитетом, образуемым одновременно делегатами бирж и делегатами федераций. Рядом с ним действуют комиссии, избираемые из …

Dos décadas antes de la fundación del Estado de Israel, Camillo Berneri advirtió del peligro de un derramamiento de sangre en Palestina, ya que los sionistas querían convertirse en los nuevos amos de ese territorio. Para Berneri, el sionismo no era solo una cortina de humo para la política imperialista británica, sino también una amenaza nacionalista y hegemónica para la coexistencia pacífica entre los nuevos colonizadores y los habitantes históricos de Palestina. Lo que, en cambio, era necesario era una situación de plena tolerancia hacia los judíos en Europa, porque solo así se podría resolver verdaderamente el problema del sionismo.

Dejemos en paz el «Muro de las Lamentaciones». No es más que el fondo del cuadro. Simbólicamente se le puede considerar el centro de la tragedia, pero históricamente no lo es. Al muro de Salomón, que jurídicamente pertenece a los árabes, los judíos acudían libremente todos los viernes, desde hace diez años, para llorar la desesperación y las desgracias de su pueblo. La furia árabe nunca se ha cebado contra el elemento judío ortodoxo. Los árabes son tolerantes en materia religiosa, como buenos mahometanos. Su «fanatismo» se explica más por datos demográficos que por reminiscencias históricas y especulaciones psicológicas. La revuelta árabe ha sido, por circunstancias, antijudía; por naturaleza, simplemente xenófoba.

Tengo ante mis ojos dos entrevistas: una del doctor Weizmann, presidente de la Organización Sionista Universal, y otra de Amein Hussein, líder religioso de los árabes de Palestina. El primero afirma que es necesario que los árabes comprendan que Inglaterra no quiere modificar en absoluto su política de protección del sionismo; que es necesario facilitar la inmigración judía en la mayor medida posible. El segundo reafirma que el actual Gobierno de Palestina es contrario, tanto en su Constitución como en su política, a los árabes; exige la adopción de una forma de gobierno democrática, en la que estén representados todos los habitantes de Palestina de manera proporcional, y el abandono de la política inglesa a favor del desarrollo de un «centro nacional judío», especialmente en lo que respecta a la inmigración.

Dos posiciones claramente opuestas. Un conflicto difícilmente resoluble. ¿De qué lado está la razón? Del lado de los árabes. El sentimentalismo está fuera de lugar. Si la prensa mundial ha dado cuenta de las víctimas judías y ha descrito las horribles escenas de las masacres de colonos sionistas indefensos; si existe una justa tradición de compasión hacia los judíos víctimas de leyes absurdas e injustas y masacrados en los pogromos; si es admirable el esfuerzo sionista, todo ello se ve contrarrestado por el peso de las víctimas árabes, por el hecho de que el sionismo sirve de tapadera a la política imperialista británica y al régimen de desigualdad que impera en Palestina.

Los judíos se han declarado seguros de que en el futuro serán los hegemones en Palestina. Los árabes han visto bajar a cientos de judíos de cada barco de vapor que llegaba a Jaffa y a Haifa, han visto cómo los judíos ocupaban las zonas más propicias de su territorio, han visto cómo pasaban a manos de los judíos tierras que los agricultores árabes habían hecho fértiles, han visto cómo la mayor parte de los gastos en obras públicas …

Did the Science Wars Take Place? The Political and Ethical Stakes of Radical Realism By: William Gillis Center for a Stateless Society, 2025{1}

I follow William Gillis—veteran anarchist activist and writer, and trained physicist—on Bluesky because he’s funny, and because he makes me think. If you share his burning hatred for fascism, a sneering (remember that word) contempt for establishment liberalism, and deep disgust for Stalinists, “tankies” and other authoritarian Leftists, I’d recommend it. It also helps if you like Star Wars and Star Trek.

One reason why I enjoy his work is that he flips a lot of widely held assumptions about anarchist beliefs. For example, the clichéd response to the concept of prison/police abolition is that anarchists (or libertarian communists) must be foolish utopians who think that everyone is deep-down good. On the contrary, Gillis’s closely argued position is that some people are just plain “bad,” due to whatever combination of nature and nurture, but that these “bad” people are precisely the ones who will become cops and judges. Hence, abolition of those structures, and their replacement with informal social incentives based on game theory, is the only way to stop bad people.[1] It’s also fun, when you’re watching liberals discuss why “prison abolition” couldn’t work because the only alternative is lynch mobs, to toss in Gillis’s article on the moral imperative to Kill Your Local Rapist and see what happens.[2]

But I’ve always appreciated Gillis’s commitment to science as a concept and, more importantly, as a practice. We live in increasing conditions of “weaponised unreality”[3] where the ascendent form of “postmodern fascism” is built around not Blackshirts fighting in the streets but the creation of an “alternative reality” based on social media bubbles and captured mass-media outlets of the FOX/GB News variety, in which the downwardly mobile masses voluntarily segregate themselves. Expanding from its origins in Christian “creation science” and the tobacco industry, populist science denial has been weaponized over decades to prevent any serious attempt at mitigating climate change—and, more recently, has pushed forward from outrage at COVID-19 restrictions to “antivaxxers” apparently rejecting the germ theory of disease itself.

A strict adherence to scientific materialism used to be the common sense of the Marxist movement. In the era of the Industrial and Scientific Revolutions, with the world being turned upside down, the Communist Manifesto spoke enthusiastically about the possibility of “subjection of Nature’s forces.” The only problem was that the tools of science (and the fruits of its successes) were in the hands of the bourgeoisie, who had used it to defeat feudal oppression and were keeping it away from the exploited proletariat. In Ferdinand Lassalle’s famous phrase quoted by Rosa Luxemburg, the key to the golden future was to bring workers and science together.[4]

Så kom Bresa-Litovsk-freden. Två månader förut, i december 1917, hade Trotzky tillbakavisat med en fin gest av nobel indignation den av Tyskland erbjudna freden på villkor som voro mycket fördelaktigare för Ryssland. "Vi föra intet krig, vi underskriva ingen fred!" hade han sagt, och det revolutionära Ryssland applåderade honom. "Ingen kompromiss med den tyska imperialismen, inga medgivanden" ekade det genom landet; och folket stod färdigt att försvara sin revolution ända till döds. Men nu fordrade Lenin ratificeringen av en fred som innebar det mest modlösa förräderi mot den större delen av Ryssland, Finland, Lettland, Lithauen, Vitryssland, Bessarabien - alla gingo över till den tyska inkräktaren och deras egen bourgeoisis förtryck och exploatering.

Lenins inflytande var starkt. Han segrade. Brest-Litovsk-freden ratificerades av den 4:de sovjetkongressen.

Det var Trotzky, vilken först försäkrade under avvisande av den tyska freden på de erbjudna villkoren i december 1917 att arbetarna och bönderna, inspirerade och beväpnade av revolutionen, skullem edelst guerillakrig besegra en invasionsarmé. Vänstersocialrevolutionärerna kallade nu till bonderesningar, till kamp mot tyskarna, övertygade att ingen skulle kunna besegra den revolutionära glöden hos ett folk som kämpade för bevarande av dess stora revolutions frukter! Arbetare och bönder, lyssnade till detta upprop, bildade militärdetachement och störtade till Ukrainas och Vitrysslands hjälp, tappert skridande mot de tyska inkräktarna. Trotzky befallde ryska armén att förfölja och undertrycka dessa friskaror.

Mordet på Mirbach följde härefter.

Det var det vänstersocialrevolutionära partiets protest och utmaning mot den preussiska imperialismen i Ryssland. Bolsjevikregeringen började vidta åtgärder till deras underkuvande, den hade nu en känsla av att stå i obligation till Tyskland. Dzerzhinsky, allryska utomordentliga kommissionens ledare, fordrade terroristernas utlämnande.

Det var en unik situation i revolutionsannalerna: ett revolutionärt parti med makt krävande av ett annat revolutionärt parti, med vilket det samarbetat, arrestering och bestraffning av en revolutionär för avdagatagandet av en imperialistisk regerings representant. Brest-Litovsk-freden hade ställt bolsjevikerna i den onaturliga ställningen av en gendarm för Tyskland. Vänstersocialrevolutionärerna besvarade Dzerzhinskys fordran med den senares arrestering. Denna handling och de väpnade skärmytslingarna, som följde därpå, (ehuru obetydliga i sig själva) voro helt och hållet utförda av de bolsjevikiska politikerna. De förklarade att det var ett försök av vänstersocialrevolutionära partiet att bemäktiga sig regeringstömmarna. De förklarade detta parti fågelfritt och dess utrotning började.

Denna bolsjevikiska metod och taktik var icke av tillfällig natur. Snart blev det klart att det är den kommunistiska statens ständiga politik att krossa varje slags yttring som icke var i överensstämmelse med regeringen. Efter ratificeringen av Brest-Litovsk-freden återkallade vänstersocialrevolutionärerna sina representanter i folkkommissariernas sovjet. Bolsjevikerna voro i besittning av den ensamma kontrollen över regeringen.

Under en och annan förevändning fullföljde de den mest godtyckliga och grymma undertryckning av alla de andra politiska partierna och rörelserna. Mensjevikerna och högersocialrevolutionärerna hade "likviderats" långt förut, tillsammans med den ryska bourgeoisin.

Nu var det de revolutionära elementens tur - vänstersocialrevolutionärerna, anarkisterna, de partilösa revolutionärerna.

Men dessas "likvidation" inbegrep mycket mer än undertryckandet av små politiska grupper. Dessa revolutionära element hade strängt förföljts, vänstersocialrevolutionärerna bland bönderna, anarkisterna huvudsakligen bland stadsproletariatet. Den nya bolsjeviktaktiken inneslöt …

author: Fozzie
title: Chapter 24: The Transformation of Surplus-value into Capital
content:
Harry Cleaver's study guide to Marx's Capital volume one, chapter 24.

The employment of surplus-value as capital = accumulation of capital.

Although net revenue (sales minus costs) = surplus-value, it takes the form of money. It only becomes capital when invested in more means of production and in the hiring of more labor.

For this to happen annual production must include: whatever new means of production that are needed to replace worn-out means of production (depreciation), new means of production that can be bought by the net revenue or surplus-value, new labor power (workers) that can be hired and new means of subsistence to sustain them.

The availability of new labor-power implies wages that "suffice, not only to maintain [the existing working class], but also to increase its numbers."

"The cycle of simple reproduction alters its form and, to use Sismondi's expression, changes into a spiral."

Thus laws of private property that assume equal exchange [and indeed often prosecute unequal exchange or cheating] thus hide the real relationship. Equal exchange (assuming wages = value of labor-power) is a mere semblance - a form that mystifies the real content of the relationship, i.e., money/surplus-value (=unpaid labor) is stolen from workers.

"Originally the rights of property seemed to us to be grounded in a man's own labor." [e.g., John Locke's theory of property](1)) But in capitalism property - of the means of production - "turns out to be the right . . . to appropriate the unpaid labor of others".

"General law of commodity production" = "law of exchange" = exchange of equal values. Marx assumes this to always hold, yet exploitation exists because workers produce more value than the value of their wages.

Generalization of commodity production only occurs when labor-power becomes a commodity - which happens only with the development of capitalism - thus capitalism includes this generalization.

There are two basic points in this section. The first is that for capitalism to expand beyond simple reproduction the surpus-value earned through the exploitation of workers, and accruing to the capitalists as money realized through the sale of the commodities produced by those workers, must be invested rather than consumed. The second point is that such investment, wherein surplus-value is used to purchase new means of production and to hire new workers to expand production, doesn't violate the "laws of exchange", i.e., we can continue to assume equality in exchange. But, because the extraction of surplus-value constitutes the very unequal exploitation of workers, the "laws of exchange" hide the reality of the situation.

Investment: by corporations, by philanthropies and by the state.

In simple reproduction - where the existing situation is merely reproduced - all surplus-value is consumed, either by the capitalist class to whom it belongs or, perhaps, by the beneficiaries of any charity the capitalists might distribute to the poor. Marx doesn't discuss charity but others of his time were well aware of this use of a little bit of surplus-value. Some, such as the Reverand Thomas Malthus whom Marx both draws upon and frequently mocks, argued against it. (2) Others, such as Emile Zola, the French novelist, drew biting portraits of such condescention on the part of capitalists. (see the description in Germinal (1885)(3) of the annual charity bestowed on coal miners by the wives of the mine owners.) Beyond charity, a few extremely wealthy capitalists have employed some of the surplus-value they have extraced from workers for "philanthropy." (see below)

In expanded reproduction, or accumulation, surplus-value is used to buy more means of production and to hire more workers in order to expand both the scale of production and to expand the amount of surpus-value/money realized from enlarged sales. Such expanded reproduction in industry, however, requires that both the new means of production and the new workers be available. Therefore, current production must produce not only the means of production necessary to replace worn-out or used up means of production but also new means of production available in exchange for surplus-value that can be used to expand production. At the same time, current production must produce sufficient means of subsistence to support the expanded reproduction of the working class, i.e., the procreation and rearing of children. Thus: in the case of accumulation "ordinary wages suffice, not …

La propaganda no es y no puede ser más que la repetición continua, incansable, de aquellos principios que deben servirnos de guía en la conducta que debemos seguir en las varias contingencias de la vida.

Repetiremos, pues, con palabras más o menos diferentes, pero con un fondo constante, nuestro viejo programa socialista-anarquista-revolucionario.

Nosotros creemos que la mayor parte de los males que afligen a los hombres dependen de la mala organización social, y que los hombres, si quisieran y supieran cómo, podrían destruirlos.

La sociedad actual es el resultado de las luchas seculares libradas por los hombres. No comprendiendo las ventajas que podrían sacar de la cooperación y de la solidaridad, viendo en los demás hombres (excepto lo más vecinos por los vínculos de la sangre) un competidor y un enemigo, han procurado acaparar, cada uno para sí, la mayor cantidad posible de disfrutes sin preocuparse por los intereses de los demás.

Dada esta lucha, naturalmente debían salir vencedores los más fuertes o los más afortunados, y de una u otra forma, someter y oprimir a los vencidos.

Mientras el hombre no fué capaz de producir sino lo que necesitaba para su sostén, los vencedores no podían hacer otra cosa que matar al vencido y apoderarse de los alimentos por éste cosechados.

Más tarde, cuando con el descubrimiento del pastoreo y del la agricultura un hombre pudo ya producir mas de lo que necesitaba para vivir, los vencedores encontraron mas ventajoso reducir a los vencidos a esclavitud y hacerles producir para sus dueños.

Más tarde aún, los vencedores se dieron cuenta de que era más cómodo, más productivo, y más seguro explotar el trabajo ajeno con otro sistema: retener la propiedad exclusiva de la tierra y de todos los medios de trabajo, y dejar nominalmente libres a los despojados, los cuales, no teniendo ya medios con que vivir, venían obligados a recurrir a los propietarios y a trabajar para éstos en las condiciones que éstos querían.

De este modo, poquito a poco, a través de toda una red complicadísima de luchas de todo género, invasiones, guerras, rebeliones, represiones, concesiones arrancadas, asociaciones de vencidos unidos para la defensa y de vencedores unidos para la ofensa, se ha llegado al estado actual de la sociedad, en la cual unos cuantos detienen hereditariamente la tierra y toda la riqueza social, mientras la gran masa de los hombres, desheredada de todo, se ve explotada y oprimida por unos poco propietarios.

De este estado de cosas depende el estado de miseria en que generalmente se encuentran los trabajadores y por consiguiente todos los males que de la miseria derivan: ignorancia, delitos, prostitución, la abyección física causada por la desnutrición, la depresión mental, y la muerte prematura. De este modo depende la constitución de una clase especial (el gobierno), la cual, provista de medios materiales de represión, tiene la misión de legalizar y defender a los propietarios contra las reivindicaciones de los proletarios, sirviéndose, además, de esta fuerza, para crearse a sí misma ciertos privilegios y para someterse, cuando se puede, incluso hasta la misma clase propietaria. De esto depende la constitución de otra clase especial (el clero), la cual, con una serie de fábulas sobre la voluntad de Dios, sobre la vida futura, etc …

title: ABD'de yargıç, Trump yönetiminin Washington'daki golf sahasında yaptığı ağaç kesimini durdurdu
content:
ABD Bölge Yargıcı Ana C. Reyes, daha önce geçici tedbir kararı aldığı, başkent Washington D.C.'de Donald Trump yönetimi tarafından yaptırılan bir golf sahasındaki ağaç kesimini 26 Ekim'e kadar durdurdu.

Yargıç Reyes, "East Potomac Golf Links" isimli golf sahasındaki ağaçların bu kadar hızlı kesilmesinin, Trump yönetiminin konuyu bir "oldu bittiye getirmek" istemesinden kaynaklandığını söyledi.

Konuyla ilgili 21 sayfalık rapor hazırlayan Reyes, salı günü verdiği geçici tedbir kararını resmileştirerek, güzergahı kalıcı olarak değiştirecek herhangi bir çalışma için "72 saat önceden bildirimde bulunulmasını" şart koştu.

Reyes, Trump yönetimini, tarihi golf sahasında çalışma yapılmaması yönündeki tekrarlanan taleplerini görmezden geldiği için sert bir dille eleştirerek, "Bunun hiçbir bahanesi yok" dedi.

Yargıç, hükümet avukatlarına, bu konuda "cehaletin mazeret olarak kabul edilemeyeceğini" ifade etti.

Kadın yargıç, daha önceki bir duruşmada söz konusu sahada, "önceden haber verilmeksizin 10 ağacın bile kesilemeyeceğine" dair yaptığı uyarıyı hatırlattı.

Yönetimin avukatları ise duruşmada, hafta sonu yaklaşık 430 ağacın kesildiğini ve 299 ağacın daha kesilmesinin hedeflendiğini aktardı.

Duruşma, halka açık golf sahasında yeni ağaç kesimi yapılmasını istemeyen sivil toplum kuruluşlarının pazar günü geç saatlerde yaptığı acil bir başvurunun ardından gerçekleşti.

author: Unknown
title: İBB: İstanbul'da yağış, 1985'ten bu yana kaydedilen en yüksek değerlerden birine ulaştı
content:
İstanbul Büyükşehir Belediyesi (İBB), 14 Ekim günündeki yağışlarda 1985 yılından bu yana kaydedilen en yüksek değerlerden birine ulaşıldığını belirterek, kentin bazı noktalarında metrekareye 242 kilogram yağış düştüğünü bildirdi.

İBB'den yapılan açıklamaya göre Beykoz'da metrekareye 242 kilogram, Eyüpsultan'da 190,5 kilogram, Sarıyer'de ise 187,9 kilogram yağış düştü.

Özellikle Boğaz çevresi ile Avrupa Yakası'nın kuzey ve orta kesimlerinde metrekareye düşen yağış miktarı 100 ila 230 kilogram olarak ölçüldü.

İstanbul'un birçok noktasında metrekareye düşen yağış miktarı ise 100 kilogramı aştı.

Kaydedilen yağış miktarı, 1985 yılından bu yana görülen en yüksek değerlerden birine ulaştı.

Yağış nedeniyle İBB birimlerine toplam 6 bin 937 ihbar ulaştı. İhbarların 5 bin 711'i İSKİ'ye, 528'i Çözüm Merkezi'ne, 498'i itfaiyeye, 200'ü ise yol bakım ekiplerine iletildi.

AKOM'un meteorolojik değerlendirmelerine göre, yağışların özellikle Anadolu Yakası ve Boğaz çevresinde etkisini sürdürmesi bekleniyor. Bugün sabah saat 10.00'a kadar bazı bölgelerde metrekareye 50 ila 75 kilogram ilave yağış düşebileceği, rüzgarın ise saatte 50 ila 80 kilometre hıza ulaşabileceği tahmin ediliyor.

Vatandaşlara zorunlu olmadıkça özel araçlarıyla trafiğe çıkmamaları, mümkün olduğunca toplu ulaşımı tercih etmeleri, dere yataklarından ve su baskını riski bulunan alanlardan uzak durmaları çağrısında bulunuldu.

İBB, olumsuz hava koşulları nedeniyle vatandaşların güvenli alanlarda dinlenebilmesi için tüm sosyal tesislerini sabaha kadar açık tutacak. BELTUR'un 6 noktası da gece boyunca hizmet verecek. Vatandaşların ulaşımını kolaylaştırmak amacıyla 15 raylı sistem hattında seferler saat 02.00'ye kadar uzatıldı.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Rizomatica
title: Mogekonmen regresa en Kurarewe: tres días para encontrarse con la gastronomía Mapuche y los saberes territoriales que la sostienen
content:
El 30 y 31 de octubre y 1 de noviembre de 2026 se realizará la 2° versión del Festival de Gastronomía Mapuche MOGEKONMEN, un encuentro que reunirá a cocineras, cocineros, recolectoras, huerteras, cultores e invitados de distintos territorios para compartir experiencias en torno a la alimentación, la cultura y la memoria mapuche.


Después de su primera versión en 2025, el Festival de Gastronomía Mapuche se prepara para recibir nuevamente a quienes quieran conocer, compartir y disfrutar de una cocina profundamente vinculada con el territorio y sus formas de vida.


Durante tres jornadas (viernes, sábado y domingo), Kurarewe será escenario de un encuentro que busca ir más allá de las preparaciones y los sabores. MOGEKONMEN propone conocer las historias que existen detrás de los alimentos: cómo se cultivan, dónde se recolectan, quiénes conservan las semillas y de qué manera estos conocimientos continúan transmitiéndose entre generaciones.


El festival es autogestionado y surge del trabajo que cocineras y cocineros de Kurarewe que realizan durante todo el año. Detrás de estos tres días hay meses de organización, encuentros y esfuerzos compartidos, sostenidos por el compromiso de quienes creen en la importancia de mantener vivos los conocimientos alimentarios de su territorio.


Una cocina que comienza mucho antes de llegar a la mesa


En los territorios mapuche cordilleranos, muchos conocimientos alimentarios se mantienen a través de prácticas cotidianas: el trabajo en las huertas, la recolección de hongos y frutos, el cuidado de las semillas, la preparación de alimentos de temporada y el aprendizaje junto a las personas mayores.


 Estas experiencias forman parte de lo que MOGEKONMEN busca compartir con sus visitantes, reconociendo que la cocina no comienza cuando se enciende el fuego, sino mucho antes, en la relación que las personas mantienen con la naturaleza y su territorio.


Tres jornadas de cocina, conversación y encuentro


La segunda versión de MOGEKONMEN contempla actividades que permitirán acercarse a la gastronomía mapuche desde diferentes experiencias: seminario interdisciplinario de saberes, encuentro con personas dedicadas al resguardo y transmisión de conocimientos alimentarios, cocina en vivo, una feria gastronómica y artesanal de productores y productoras locales, música, cine indígena, astroturismo y espacio dedicado especialmente para niños y niñas.


En esta segunda versión nos encontraremos con destacadas cocineras y chef de los pueblos aymara, huilliche, lafkenche y también desde Perú. Todos ellos compartirán sus experiencias desde la cocina, la investigación y el trabajo desarrollado en sus respectivas zonas.


Junto con acercar estos conocimientos al público, MOGEKONMEN busca contribuir al fortalecimiento de la economía local y dar visibilidad al trabajo de cocineras, recolectoras, huerteras, productores y artesanos que forman parte de la vida del territorio de Kurarewe, actual Región de la Araucanía.


Kurarewe vuelve a abrir su despensa al mundo

.


Este año, el festival vuelve a abrir sus puertas para compartir preparaciones, escuchar historias y conocer a las personas y territorios que hacen posible esta cocina.


MOGEKONMEN es también un escenario para hablar de las implicancias de las nuevas políticas y decisiones sobre el uso de los territorios. Queremos hablar sobre el rol fundamental de las mujeres en la transmisión de conocimientos en los pueblos originarios, el futuro de los bosques, las aguas y la biodiversidad, creemos necesario escuchar a quienes han convivido y cuidado estos espacios por generaciones. Porque hablar de nuestros alimentos también es hablar de los lugares que permiten que sigan existiendo.


Esta segunda versión cuenta con el apoyo del área Küme Mogen (vivir bien y en armonía) de la iniciativa Füta Mawiza, cuyo trabajo busca contribuir al resguardo del territorio y fortalecer la gobernanza local para proteger las formas de vida y la naturaleza de las cabeceras de cuenca.


El 2° Festival de Gastronomía Mapuche MOGEKONMEN se realizará los días viernes 30 y sábado 31 de octubre y domingo 1 de noviembre de 2026, en Kurarewe, a aproximadamente 140 kilómetros de Temuco, hacia la cordillera.


La programación completa y otras novedades estarán disponibles en las redes sociales oficiales del festival.


Esta información se publicó en

Radio Kurruf

.

author: Unknown
title: İzmir Emek ve Demokrasi Güçleri’nden Halk TV’ye destek: “Haber alma özgürlüğü engellendi"
content:
İzmir – İzmir Emek ve Demokrasi Güçleri, Halk TV’ye kayyım atanmasına tepki göstermek için basın açıklaması düzenledi. Alsancak Türkan Saylan Kültür Merkezi önünde düzenlenen açıklamada sık sık “Karanlığa teslim olmayacağız”, “Özgür basın susturulamaz”, “AKP gidecek, biz kalacağız” sloganları atıldı. Basın metnini KESK İzmir Dönem Sözcüsü Savaş Candemir okudu.

AKP iktidarının sürdürdüğü baskı ve sindirme politikalarını yaşamın her alanına yaymaya devam ettiğini belirten Candemir, “Belediyelerden demokratik kurumlara, dijital mecralardan muhalif basına uzanan kayyım, sansür ve yasak politikalarının son hedefi Halk TV oldu” dedi.

Halk TV’ye yönelik polis operasyonunun, kanala kayyım atanmasının ve yayınların durdurulmasının yalnızca bir televizyon kanalına yönelik müdahale olarak değerlendirilemeyeceğini vurgulayan Candemir, “Bu uygulama, basın özgürlüğü, halkın haber alma hakkı ve demokratik toplumun temel değerleri açısından son derece ciddi bir gelişmedir. Bunun bir başka örneğini TELE 1’de de yaşadık. TELE 1’e sadece kayyım atanmamış, adeta TELE 1 yok edilerek haber kanalı belgesel ve magazin kanalına dönüştürülmüş, halkın haber alma özgürlüğü engellenmiştir” diye konuştu.

Bugün Halk TV’ye yönelik müdahalenin, ülkemizde uzun süredir yaşanan demokratik gerilemeden, seçilmiş iradelere yönelik kayyım uygulamalarından, gazetecilere dönük baskılardan ve toplumsal muhalefetin sesini sınırlayan politikalardan bağımsız değerlendirilemeyeceğini söyleyen Candemir, “Bu saldırılar birbirinden bağımsız değil; tek merkezden yürütülen, toplumsal muhalefeti susturmayı, halkın iradesini gasp etmeyi ve haber alma hakkını ortadan kaldırmayı, demokrasinin asgari kurum ve kurallarını ortadan kaldırarak otoriter tek adam rejimini kalıcı hâle getirmeyi hedefleyen politikanın parçalarıdır” ifadelerini kullandı.

Son dönemde milyarlarca dolarlık fon yolsuzluğu, Mekke Anlaşması kapsamında Yemen’e müdahale etme ihtimali ve bugün başlayan Ekrem İmamoğlu savunması gündemdeki yerini korurken, muhalif basına yönelik bu müdahalelerin söz konusu yolsuzluğun ve hukuksuzlukların üzerinin örtülmek ve muhalif medyada tartışılmasının engellenmek istendiğini gösterdiğini belirten Candemir şunları söyledi: “Siyasi iktidarın, toplumsal muhalefetin sesini kısmaya ve farklı görüşlerin kamuoyuna ulaşmasını engellemeye yönelik uygulamaları kabul edilemez. Basın kuruluşlarının bağımsızlığına yönelik her türlü müdahale, yalnızca gazetecilerin çalışma koşullarını değil, toplumun doğru ve özgür bilgiye erişim hakkını da doğrudan hedef almaktadır.”

Basın özgürlüğünün demokratik bir toplumun vazgeçilmez bir unsuru olduğunu vurgulayan Candemir, “Gazetecilerin özgürce haber yapabildiği, farklı görüşlerin baskı görmeden ifade edilebildiği, medya kuruluşlarının siyasi müdahalelerden bağımsız çalışabildiği bir ülke istiyoruz. Hukukun üstünlüğü, ifade özgürlüğü ve demokratik haklar herkes için güvence altında olmalıdır. Hiçbir güç, basın özgürlüğünü ortadan kaldırmanın veya halkın haber alma hakkını sınırlandırmanın aracı hâline getirilmemelidir. Hukuk, herkese eşit uygulanmalı; adalet, siyasi hesaplaşmaların aracı hâline getirilmemelidir” dedi.

Yargıyı, kolluğu, kayyımları ve dijital sansürü birer baskı aracına dönüştürerek ülkenin her geçen gün daha koyu bir karanlığa sürüklendiğini vurgulayan Candemir, “Bilinmelidir ki bu çabaları beyhudedir. Tarih sayısız kere göstermiştir ki hiçbir iktidar baskıyla, yasaklarla ve zorbalıkla ömrünü sonsuza kadar uzatamamıştır” diye konuştu.

İzmir Emek ve Demokrasi Güçleri olarak Halk TV emekçileriyle dayanışma içinde olacaklarını vurgulayan Candemir, “Tüm emek ve demokrasi güçlerini bu hukuksuzluğa karşı ortak mücadeleyi büyütmeye çağırıyoruz. Çünkü biliyoruz ki bu örgütlü kötülüğü dağıtacak olan ortak mücadele ve dayanışmadır. Emeğin, barışın, özgürlüğün ve demokrasinin kazandığı bir geleceği mutlaka birlikte kuracağız” ifadelerini kullandı.

title: Meteoroloji'den yağış alarmı: 48 ilde sarı, 5 ilde turuncu kodlu uyarı
content:
İçişleri Bakanı Mustafa Çiftçi, Meteoroloji Genel Müdürlüğü'nün son değerlendirmelerine göre 14-16 Ekim tarihleri arasında 48 il için sarı, 5 il için turuncu kodlu uyarı verildiğini açıkladı. Çiftçi, özellikle Marmara Bölgesi’nde yağışların yer yer çok kuvvetli olmasının beklendiğini bildirdi.

Muhtemel olumsuzluklara karşı Afyonkarahisar, Tokat, Muğla, Kütahya ve Eskişehir’den ilave ekip ve ekipman desteği sağlanmıştır. Yarın yoğun yağış beklenen Sakarya ve çevresinde de olası müdahale ihtiyaçları için hazırlıklarımızı tamamladık. Yaşanan olumsuzluklar sırasında elektrik çarpması sonucu bir vatandaşımızın hayatını kaybettiğini derin bir üzüntüyle öğrendim. Hayatını kaybeden vatandaşımıza Allah’tan rahmet, kederli ailesine ve yakınlarına başsağlığı diliyorum. Tedbir hayat kurtarır. Bu süreçte vatandaşlarımızdan, yetkili kurumlarımızca yapılan açıklama ve yönlendirmelere riayet etmelerini, gerekli tedbirleri almalarını önemle rica ediyorum. author: APTN National News
title: Delta police say 3rd person from Tsawwassen crash has died
content:
The Delta police say a third person has died as a result of a truck crashing into people on a walk organized by

Tsawwassen First Nation

 to mark the National Day for Truth and Reconciliation.


According to police, Gwenyth Brigit Dwyn, 64, of South Delta died in hospital.


Another person who was taken to hospital after the Sept. 30 incident has been released.


Tsawwassen First Nation Elders Virginia Splockton and wilapiya (Barb Joe), were pronounced dead at the scene.


In the aftermath of the crash, people across the country speculated about whether the crash was intentional. Police said the investigation continues.


“The possibility that the driver experienced a medical event prior to the collisions remains under investigation,” a statement from police said. “Based on the evidence reviewed to date, investigators have not identified evidence indicating that the collision was targeted or ideologically motivated.


Police said investigators remain in contact with the victim’s families and Tsawwassen First Nation.


Investigators continue to gather and assess evidence to determine the full circumstances of this collision. If the evidence establishes criminality, any potential charges will be forwarded to Crown Counsel for assessment, according to the

Delta Police Department.


“We understand that the community has questions and wants answers about what occurred,” says Staff Sergeant Mike Whiteley, Media Relations Officer.


“Our responsibility is to ensure those answers are based on a complete and objective examination of the evidence. Investigators are working through a significant amount of information, and it is important that we not reach conclusions before that work is complete.”

Delta police say 3rd person from Tsawwassen crash has died

APTN News

author: Dennis Ward
title: Feds say Federation of Sovereign Indigenous Nations still on the hook for $12M
content:
A political organization that lobbies on behalf of 74 First Nations in Saskatchewan has been ordered to pay back millions to the federal government, APTN News has learned.


The

Federation of Sovereign Indigenous Nations

 (FSIN) has been told to repay the federal government $12.3 million in transactions that were determined to be ineligible following Indigenous Services Canada’s review of the forensic audit of funding.


APTN News has obtained a copy of a letter from Indigenous Services Canada to the FSIN, date October 14, 2026.


The request for repayment follows a review of the FSIN for the period of April 1, 2019, to March 31, 2024 and according to the letter is “now considered a debt owning to the Crown” according to the letter.


The initial forensic audit found over $34 million in “questionable, ineligible or unsupported spending.”


FSIN Chief Bobby Cameron. Photo: APTN.


According to that audit, $23.4 million in COVID-19 funding was been deemed questionable, ineligible or unsupported, in part because Indigenous Services Canada was unable to “obtain complete supporting documentation to determine eligibility,” according to the summary

.


The

 audit

 also called into question funding used for payments to a former employer, administration fees, the new FSIN office building and more.


The

letter from ISC sent to the FSIN

 Wednesday said “as outlined in section 25 of your funding agreement, please contact us within 30 calendar days of this letter or provide payment in full to the Receiver of Canada.”


The letter states “ISC is seeking immediate repayment in full by November 13, 2026. Should repayment not be received, ISC would begin to set-off against any funding currently payable to the FSIN. Canada will be formalizing this debt via a Statement of Claim.”


According to the contribution agreements listed in the letter, the money that ISC is asking to be repaid was provided to the FSIN for community infrastructure, child and family services and health promotion & disease prevention.


APTN News has reached out to the FSIN for comment but has not heard back.


The post

Feds say Federation of Sovereign Indigenous Nations still on the hook for $12M

 appeared first on

APTN News

.

author: Sharon Zhang
title: Most Americans Say Trump’s Presidential Profits Are Illegal or Unethical
content:
Meanwhile, Trump reportedly ousted Guilfoyle because he was upset that she was making money off his presidency.

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

A strong majority of Americans believe that President Donald Trump is profiting illegally or unethically from his presidency, polling finds.

AP-NORC poll results released Tuesday find that 41 percent of U.S. adults say that Trump has acted illegally in personally profiting from his position, while another 18 percent say that those actions are unethical, for a total of 59 percent. In contrast, only 18 percent of people say that he has done nothing wrong.

Even a sizable proportion of Republicans, at 32 percent, believe that Trump has acted illegally or unethically in seeking private gain, the poll found.

Meanwhile, an even larger proportion believe that Trump is prioritizing his personal profits while acting as president. Fifty-six percent said he is prioritizing his profits “a lot,” while 19 percent said “some.” This stands in stark contrast to only 23 percent of people saying that he is prioritizing the country “a lot” and only 11 percent saying he’s focusing on “people like me.”

Corruption allegations have become rather common during Trump’s second term.

Trump has disclosed making $2.2 billion in income in 2025. Much of those profits came from the president’s crypto schemes and his meme coin that he launched three days before his second inauguration. His promotions of these schemes have often been openly corrupt; at least twice, for instance, Trump has encouraged buyers to become the biggest holders of the coin in order to gain access to an exclusive dinner with him.

Trump and his team hardly try to hide his many other avenues of income that are boosted by his presidency. His financial team trades prolifically, often in relation to his decisions. His practice of hosting foreign leaders and power brokers at his resorts has multiplied during this term. Earlier this year, Truth Social unrolled a program to allow traders and banks to buy access to Trump’s Truth Social posts — which often move markets — at the “fastest” speed, allowing them to access information quicker than others could react.

Trump has openly bragged about the power of wielding the Oval Office; earlier this year, he said that his children have “inside information” whenever they make any sort of investment or purchase. He has also defended his profits, claiming that he doesn’t “get involved” with his personal finances and that “we have funds that run my money.”

But Trump is still aware of the public perception of corruption surrounding his administration. This week, he ordered the ouster of U.S. ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle after reports found that she had asked a Trump donor to pay off a $100,000 credit card bill in exchange for access to the administration.

According to the Wall Street Journal, Trump grew incensed at Guilfoyle because he was upset that she was profiting off of his presidency. His aides, meanwhile, were concerned about more headlines describing the Trump administration’s self-dealing ahead of the midterm elections.

author: Leanne Sanders
title: Advocate says chiefs, grassroots working to get 145,000 registered First Nations to vote in Alberta referendum
content:
An Indigenous political activist and advocate says chiefs in Alberta, along with grassroots organizers says they’re doing everything they can to get First Nations people out to vote in the Oct. 19 referendum which could open a path for Alberta to pursue a formal separation process.

With the vote less than a week away, a key strategist says mobilization has been underway since Premier Danielle Smith introduced legislation making it easier for separatists to mount a successful petition to force a referendum.

“It really started in May 2025 when the chiefs called an emergency meeting, and the response back then was to her first legislative piece, Bill 54. The chiefs came in very firm 100 per cent opposed to separation prepared to fight. They ordered her by letter, and they all signed off on the letter to cease and desist on her separation intention,” Cara Currie Hall told APTN News in an interview.

Bill 54 was an omnibus bill that received Royal Assent in May, 2025. It included a number of changes related to the electoral process in Alberta including lifting the ban on corporate and union political donations for provincial elections and direct democracy processes like referendums and introduced a $5,000 annual contribution limit and a $5 million general election spending limit for political parties.

The separation question is number 10 on the ballot. It reads: “Should Alberta remain a province of Canada, or should the Government of Alberta commence the legal process required under the Canadian Constitution to hold a binding provincial referendum on whether or not Alberta should separate from Canada?”

Voters are then given two options to choose from: Option 1: Alberta should remain a province of Canada or Option 2: The Government of Alberta should commence the legal process required under the Canadian Constitution to hold a binding provincial referendum on whether or not Alberta should separate from Canada.

Currie Hall was a key figure in the Rock the Indigenous Vote movement in Canada in 2015 and helped organize Indigenous voters in the United States to back Barack Obama in his presidential run. She’s lending her considerable political savvy to the chiefs in Alberta and contends it was easy to see what Smith’s intentions were in making legislative changes.

“Because by then, [Smith] already lowered the threshold of signatures required to advance a referendum, and she lowered it from 60 per cent required signatures… to only 10 per cent, which is how she got away with only needing a hundred and seventy seven thousand signatures to push forward for a referendum. So, she accommodated that right from the get go.”

Currie Hall has been working alongside chiefs and grassroots people at her home First Nation of Maskwacis, 96 km south of Edmonton, to inform members of the importance of this vote. That work follows legal challenges mounted by several First Nations against Alberta over the constitutionality of the referendum.

Athabasca Chipewyan First Nation and the Blackfoot Confederacy (including Siksika Nation, Piikani Nation, and Blood Tribe with a total of at least five to six distinct First Nations/groups) brought successful judicial reviews and legal challenges that led the Court of King’s Bench to quash the separation petition and rule that the province breached its constitutional duty to consult.

Sturgeon Lake Cree Nation is suing the Alberta government, the chief electoral officer, and the federal attorney general in a separate lawsuit over Bill 14 and the separation petition process. Sturgeon Lake Cree said the referendum breached the treaties which pre-dated the province of Alberta.

APTN requested an interview with the chief but were advised he is not giving interviews at this time. Instead, in an emailed statement Sunshine said they’ve been informing and educating members “ever since Danielle Smith announced there would be an unconstitutional, expensive, and divisive referendum…”

“We hope that when all votes are counted Albertans will have repudiated this farcical anti -Treaty, anti-immigrant, and anti-democratic process,” Sunshine said.

Onion Lake Cree Nation which straddles the Alberta-Saskatchewan boundary also revived a separate lawsuit against Alberta’s broader Sovereignty Within a United Canada Act over related constitutional and treaty concerns. It claimed the provincial legislation infringes on constitutionally protected treaty rights.

author: Unknown
title: Le hussard noir tombe du toit / une émission de Minuit Décousu
content:
Après notre émission sur le début du mouvement lycéen à Lyon, on continue à suivre la mobilisation en passant cette fois la porte des établissements actuellement vides pour voir ce qu'il reste des fameux hussards noirs de la République et comprendre l'origine du malaise qui a poussé autant de jeunes dans les rues.


Cette semaine, cela fait déjà près d'une vingtaine de jours que le mouvement lycéen et désormais également étudiant s'est emparé des rues lyonnaises quasi quotidiennement. Partout, les lycées ont encore leurs portes solidement fermées voire barricadées de peur de la résurgence des rassemblement lycéens aux portes des établissements, malgré la répression inédite menée conjointement par la préfecture et le rectorat. Depuis notre dernière émission, où l'on écoutait dans des entretiens fleuves des lycéen-nes lyonnais-es nous parler de leurs premiers blocages, de l'organisation et des perspectives du mouvement, la répression a tenté de dégager la mobilisation des abords des établissements pour lui faire gagner la respectabilité des mobilisation sociales traditionnelles. Pourtant, la jeunesse continue de prouver jour après jour sa détermination à poursuivre le mouvement, selon son propre agenda.


Pour cette émission, on voulait aller voir ce qu'il se passait en interne dans les établissements scolaires pour comprendre l'origine du malaise qui a poussé autant de jeunes dans la rue. On est donc allés tourner dans la manifestation du 13 octobre à Lyon, où l'on écoute à nouveau des lycéen-nes, mais aussi des étudiant-es nous parler de l'avancée de leur mobilisation et la manière dont les établissements du second degré et du supérieur tentent coûte que coûte de mater la révolte en interne en gardant leurs portes fermées. Dans cette même manif', on s'est entretenu avec des profs de lycées de quartiers populaires ayant connu de nombreux blocages qui nous expliquent concrètement ce qu'il se passe dans les établissements fantômatiques depuis ces 20 derniers jours. . On écoute aussi une camarade prof de lettre en réseau d'éducation prioritaire renforcé (REP+) de banlieue lyonnaise, qui revient à notre micro sur les évolutions de l'éducation ces 10 dernières années, sur l'absence complète de démocratie dans les bahuts et sur le fossé grandissant entre l'ordre et la morale pronés par les adultes et les désirs de révolution des jeunes. Pour saupoudrer le tout d'un peu d'histoire, on est allés repiquer les archives du mouvement lycéen de 1971 à Villeurbanne dans le 2ème numéro des

Informations Rassemblées à Lyon

 (IRL).


L'émission s'écoute sur notre

audioblog

, ici, et un peu partout en podcast. Bonne écoute !


Minuit Décousu, c'est un fanzine radiophonique nocturne sur

Radio Canut

 (Lyon et alentours),

Radio Vassivière

 (Limousin) et

Cause Commune

 (Paris/IDF). Semaine après semaine pendant une heure, on en découd avec la nuit et on tire les fils de sons, de textes, d'archives et de voix qui s'entremêlent.

author: Ju-Hyun Park
title: Progressives Shouldn’t Call on Trump to Restore Military Exercises in Korea
content:
More than 20 Democrats signed a letter calling on Trump to maintain escalatory policies against North Korea.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

The Korean Peninsula was thrust back into the spotlight this August following a surprise announcement from U.S. President Donald Trump that the annual Ulchi Freedom Shield joint U.S.-South Korea military exercises would be partially cancelled. In his typical meandering style, Trump simultaneously claimed the decision stemmed from his “very good relationship” with Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (DPRK) President Kim Jong Un, and his growing frustration with the Republic of Korea (ROK), which he said had rebuffed his calls to join the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran. While politicians and the media clamored over whether the decision was justified, few questioned the basic assumption that the U.S. military protects the Korean people or regional stability.

Trump’s up-and-down engagement with the DPRK has been a recurring story throughout his political career. It is one of the most ridiculed aspects of his presidency, and also one of the most misunderstood. At the root of this is a persistent ignorance concerning the true nature of Washington’s history and interests in Korea.

Democrats soon moved to convey their disapproval. DropSite News leaked a letter signed by 22 Democratic members of Congress expressing “alarm” at Trump’s decision, essentially urging the president to maintain a commitment to a cycle of military escalation and brinksmanship in Korea. “This decision has strained a 73-year alliance and risks undermining readiness, security, and deterrence on the Korean Peninsula,” the signatories warned. The letter was quietly published by House Democrats after the leak.

To be sure, there is much to criticize about the manner and purpose for why the Trump government made this choice to scale back these war drills in August. But it is important to recognize that Trump’s decision had little effect on the military situation. Ulchi Freedom Shield is a significant series of war drills, but it is far from the only one. In 2025, U.S. Forces Korea conducted 274 days of similar war exercises. Cancelling just a few is a drop in the bucket, and did nothing to meet his stated goal of advancing dialogue with the DPRK — which would have required stepping back from the prevailing framework of denuclearization.

So what was Trump’s purpose? In the weeks since, it has become apparent that Trump’s decision was a maneuver to pressure Seoul to concede on other matters: deliveries on the ROK’s promised $350 billion in tariff-related investments to the U.S., and joining the war on Iran. Today, South Korea is seeing a growing protest movement to prevent Seoul from capitulating to this pressure. The real issue is not Trump’s reduction of military drills; it is the U.S. war machine in Korea, and Democrats are part of this problem.

Calls for elected Democrats to drop their hawkish rhetoric on North Korea have gone unheeded. At a time when Washington is engaged in numerous destructive wars around the world, many of them escalated under Trump 2.0, the old guard of the Democratic Party is stubbornly clinging to a Cold War vision of the Korean Peninsula that can only lead to further escalation and instability.

The U.S. military has occupied Korea since 1945, when Washington made the decision to divide the peninsula into separate occupation zones, rather than permit the Korean people to organize an independent government. The U.S. military occupation in the south waged a brutal counterinsurgency war to crush a series of popular rebellions, and established the Republic of Korea (ROK) under the lead of Syngman Rhee, a staunchly pro-U.S. and anti-communist political figure. Even before the official start of the Korean War in 1950, the U.S. and ROK killed over 100,000 Koreans in the south alone.

Opposing war drills in Korea is fundamentally about opposing the violence of military occupation and Washington’s role in prolonging the Korean War.

The war itself brought only further destruction. In the south, the U.S. designated civilian refugees as enemy combatants, leading to atrocities like No Gun Ri, in which U.S. soldiers massacred hundreds of Korean refugees after evacuating them from their homes south of the 38th parallel. author: Chris Walker
title: Trump’s New Press Sec Faces Scrutiny Over Lawyer Claims, Anti-Abortion Views
content:
Zacharia’s claims of being a lawyer and her spreading of anti-abortion disinformation have received renewed examination.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

Following White House Press Secretary Katie Zacharia’s first appearance before the media on Tuesday, numerous aspects of her background have come to light — including her staunch anti-abortion views and that she may have lied about her résumé.

Zacharia has claimed she is a lawyer, noting that she graduated from law school at Pepperdine University. However, no record of her passing a bar exam in any state exists, which is generally a requirement before a person can practice law. In states without that requirement, would-be lawyers usually have to submit an application to the state’s bar association, but there is no record of her applying in those jurisdictions either.

Asked by reporters this week where she passed the bar exam, Zacharia responded, “When I moved to China.” But critics have pointed out that a person cannot take a state bar exam while outside of the U.S.

White House press secretaries are not required to have an educational degree, let alone be a lawyer. However, the fact that Zacharia has possibly misled others about her personal history raises the question of whether she can be forthright or honest in her new role.

Perhaps more concerning are Zacharia’s views on reproductive rights. From November 2023 to February 2026, she served on the board of advisors for an organization called “White Rose Resistance,” an anti-abortion group that stole its name from a Nazi Germany-era resistance group that had nothing to do with the issue.

The contemporary White Rose Resistance has pushed for charging people with murder if they receive an abortion or help to facilitate one. On the organization’s FAQ page, the group downplays the possibility of a death penalty sentence for those found “guilty” of having an abortion while also not outright denying that it could happen.

After leaving the organization, Zacharia has pushed an anti-abortion agenda through the use of disinformation. In an interview from October 2026, she pointedly stated that “the abortion pill has the same chemicals that they used…in camps in Nazi Germany” — a verifiably false claim.

The decision to hire Zacharia as the Trump administration’s new press secretary could indicate that the White House may focus on abortion following the upcoming midterm elections. Indeed, according to a report from The Washington Sun, the Department of Justice (DOJ) has been instructed to move more slowly on abortion-related cases until after November, picking up attacks on abortion rights and access once the elections are over.

Abortion rights proponents have decried the appointment of Zacharia.

“Donald Trump is handing the anti-abortion disinformation movement one of the biggest megaphones in government,” Reproductive Freedom for All President and CEO Mini Timmaraju said in a statement. “Katie Zacharia is the latest anti-abortion extremist Trump has installed in his administration. We must put a check on their fringe agenda this November and block their plan to ban abortion after the midterms.”

On Tuesday, Zacharia stumbled at many moments during her first appearance as press secretary, and only took three questions from reporters (from Trump-friendly news outlets) after giving her initial remarks. Sources close to the White House said it was a rough start for her.

“You either got it or don’t. And she don’t got it,” one source connected to the administration told Politico.

“She needs to get much better, fast. Otherwise, she’ll break Scaramucci’s record,” a White House official said to MS NOW, referring to former White House communications director Anthony Scaramucci, who only served for 11 days in Trump’s first term.
